title: Add Visual Separation Between Sketchpad Detail Panel Sections
description: Add a small vertical gap between sections in the sketchpad detail panel so adjacent groups look visually separated. Update the existing implementation and tests as needed; do not create new test files.
summary: Doubled sketchpad detail-panel plane section spacing by raising section top margin to 64px, section bottom margin to 48px, and section content gap to 16px. Updated the inline Design Playwright spacing assertions and hardened the ticket-local measurement probe to avoid blindly hiding the details panel. Verified the sketchpad build succeeds. The existing Design Playwright test is still blocked earlier by the known selection-additive kit lookup failure, but direct DOM inspection showed the right detail panel now renders the new 64/48/16 spacing classes.
